Author: MusicManBowls
Name: Hunt Train Relay
Description: Watches Hunt Helper's recorded A-Rank train via its IPC. When every currently tracked mark is marked dead, posts a Discord embed listing each mark and its estimated respawn window, using Discord's native per-viewer local-time timestamps. Also supports manual scouting reports.
Punchline: Posts your hunt train's finish time + per-mark respawn estimates to Discord.
